main.description: Lists indexed Certified profiles with pagination. Authentication is not required.

sortDirection.description: Sort by a valid zoned createdAt, otherwise indexedAt, falling back to row creation time; URI breaks ties. Default desc.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to sortDirection; keep parameters unchanged between pages. Pages are not a snapshot.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A pagination parameter is invalid, repeated where scalar, or unsupported.

errors.name: ProfileQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed profiles could not be queried.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when pagination is complete.
